articles.title: Two Giant Black Holes May Be Circling Toward a Crash
articles.summary: Astronomers found signs of two supermassive black holes orbiting each other in a distant galaxy, and they might merge in as little as 100 years.

articles.title: Ancient Japanese Communities Found Ways to Adapt After a Huge Eruption
articles.summary: A study of a volcano that erupted in Japan 7,300 years ago shows some ancient communities shrank while others moved, adapted and grew.

articles.title: AI Tool Helps Scientists Read the Messages Cells Send Each Other
articles.summary: MIT researchers built an AI model called IRIS that figures out which chemical signals guided cells as an embryo developed.
